form.label: Scan jobs & reports
form.description: Every rescan launched from CVE response, Inventory, Saved CVEs or the r7rescan command. The poller (scheduled search, every minute) starts the Rapid7 scans, checks their status until they finish, then re-reads software and findings and compares them with the snapshot saved at launch. This page refreshes every 60 s.

input.label: Hostname or IP in the job

search.query: | r7scanstatus limit=500 | search status="$j_status$" | where like(lower(coalesce(cve,"")." ".coalesce(reason,"")), lower("%$j_cve$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(software,"")." ".coalesce(reason,"")), lower("%$j_sw$%")) AND ("$j_from$"="" OR substr(created,1,10)>="$j_from$") | where like(lower(coalesce(hosts,"")), lower("%$j_host$%")) | table job_id status reason launched_from launched_by servers rapid7_scans created finished result error
| r7scanstatus job=$job|s$ view=results | stats count as servers by cve_result version_change installed

format.colorPalette: {"CVE fixed":#53A051,"Not vulnerable":#53A051,"Still vulnerable":#DC4E41,"Newly found":#DC4E41,"Not verified":#F8BE34,"No Rapid7 check yet":#708794,"Rescanned":#53A051,"Rescanned, no login":#F8BE34}

search.query: | r7scanstatus job=$job|s$ view=results | table hostname ip env_label appname scan_login installed version_before last_scan_before version_after version_change range_status_after cve_before cve_after cve_result last_scan_after

format.colorPalette: {"CVE fixed":#53A051,"Not vulnerable":#53A051,"Still vulnerable":#DC4E41,"Newly found":#DC4E41,"Not verified":#F8BE34,"No Rapid7 check yet":#708794,"Rescanned":#53A051,"Rescanned, no login":#F8BE34}

html.p: CVE fixed: Rapid7 found the CVE before, and this job's scan assessed the server, logged in (software data returned) and no longer finds it. Not verified: the server was not assessed by this job's scan, or the scan returned no software data (login failed), so the app does not call it fixed. No Rapid7 check yet: only the version comparison applies. Rescanned / Rescanned, no login: a server-only rescan (no CVE chosen) reached the server, with or without a working login. Export any table with the Export button (CSV or PDF).
